headline: Does Sales Momentum Change The Bull Case For Home Depot Stock?
summary: Home Depot is seeing firmer sales trends, with comparable average ticket up 2.8% year over year and comparable transactions down 1%, while Pro customer spending and big ticket purchases above $1,000 remain relatively resilient despite pressure on larger renovation projects. The retailer is pairing that operating performance with brand focused moves such as a limited edition holiday sweater bundle and seasonal restocks.
